verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Perfect Shot as a Ki Blast Super with a slow, mildly tracking projectile, costing 100 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Training with Cell (Perfect) is the documented acquisition route; current mentor documentation lists Perfect Shot as Cell's second skill reward.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes instructor training rather than a PQ reward condition, so the field remains null.

records.name: Perfect Shot
records.character_source: Cell (Perfect), Cell (Full Power), Cell (Full Power) Supervillain, and customizable partner documented by current references
records.skill_description: A Ki Blast Super that charges a green Ki blast at the fingertips before firing a slow projectile with mild tracking.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material classifies Perfect Shot as a slow, tracking projectile. The projectile continues its attack sequence after the user is free to move, allowing follow-up attacks. Current mentor documentation places it in Cell (Perfect)'s second lesson.
